description: Fleet-wide health for every decdn-node: status, delivery, slash safety, and the logs and traces that explain them. Deep dives live in the deCDN dashboard dropdown. Companion to adr/appendix-observability.md, monitoring/prometheus-alerts.yml and docs/runbook.md.

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health for job=decdn-node. Falls to zero before any decdn_ series can tell you anything.

panels.title: Chain RPC
panels.description: Worst node's view of the Arbitrum RPC. Every chain watcher and every settlement stalls behind this.

panels.title: Oldest watcher tick
panels.description: Age of the least recently ticked chain-event watcher, across all five watchers and every node. Red at 180s matches DecdnBlacklistWatcherStalled — a stalled blacklist watcher is a slash risk, not a cosmetic lag.

panels.title: Shortest uptime
panels.description: A value under 5 minutes means something restarted.

panels.title: Cache fullest node
panels.description: Highest cache utilisation in the fleet. Past the limit the eviction driver starts discarding content the network may still want.

panels.title: Lanes open
panels.description: Distinct (pool, signer, provider) keys holding unredeemed vouchers.

panels.title: Unredeemed
panels.description: Accepted-but-unredeemed voucher value. Raw USDC base units scaled to dollars. Refreshed once per redeemer tick, so it lags by up to one redeem_interval_secs.

panels.title: Throughput — served vs origin pull-through
panels.description: Their ratio is the origin-egress amplification factor: 1.0 while the fleet is a pure pass-through, trending to 0 as content gets re-served from cache.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Deliberately unguarded division: an idle node renders a gap rather than a fabricated 0%. A clamp_min on the denominator would floor a per-second rate at 1.0 and understate every low-traffic node.

panels.title: Serve refusals by reason
panels.description: Every refusal reason the serve leg records. The payment-class reasons and cache miss all collapse to the same NotFound wire code, so a client cannot tell them apart — these counters are the only place the cause survives.

panels.title: Pull funnel
panels.description: Node-to-node cache-miss pulls, where this fleet is the paying client. The gap between the two lines is the failure budget broken out beside.

panels.title: Probe-hold exhausted
panels.description: Probes for a present blob that got no eviction hold because every slot was live. Filtered to reason=exhausted on purpose: disabled is an operator choice and stake_lane_reserved has its own knob, and neither should trip the alert.

panels.title: Probe-hold saturation
panels.description: clamp_min is correct here — the denominator is an integer capacity gauge, not a rate.

panels.title: Blacklist enforcement failures
panels.description: Hashes a batched re-scope could not re-verify or evict. Non-zero means the deny-set is not fully enforced and a blacklisted blob may still be servable — directly slashable.

panels.title: Watcher task panics
panels.description: Any non-zero value is a bug. Capture the error! line and file it.

panels.title: Log events by level
panels.description: Parsed out of the JSON body. The Loki level stream label is journald's syslog priority, which is info for every line the daemon writes to stdout regardless of its real severity — do not group by it.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (count_over_time({unit="decdn-node.service", instance=~"$instance"} | json lvl="level" | lvl=~"WARN|ERROR" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Span rate by operation
panels.description: Every span here is currently produced by a dependency crate (iroh, quinn, alloy) and only exists because the log filter sits at debug. deCDN itself carries no #[instrument] attributes yet, so this panel is a placeholder that lights up when it does.

targets.expr: {unit="decdn-node.service", instance=~"$instance"} | json lvl="level", tgt="target", msg="fields.message" | lvl=~"WARN|ERROR" | line_format "{{.instance}} {{.lvl}} {{.tgt}} :: {{.msg}}"

title: deCDN — fleet overview
